hooks.command: P=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; [ -x "$P" ] || P=python3; "$P" -I "$HOME/.claude/hooks/l1-policy.py" || exit 2
P=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; [ -x "$P" ] || P=python3; "$P" -I "$HOME/.claude/hooks/ask-guard.py"
P=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; [ -x "$P" ] || P=python3; "$P" -I "$HOME/.claude/hooks/read-image-downscale.py"
P=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; [ -x "$P" ] || P=python3; "$P" -I "$HOME/.claude/hooks/usage-stop.py"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/post-compact-handoff.sh"

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
P=/opt/homebrew/bin/python3; [ -x "$P" ] || P=python3; "$P" -I "$HOME/.claude/hooks/auto-do.py"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/speak.sh"
